gaps.explanation: The Road Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p10) prints Local 73,347 and TOTAL RECEIPTS 1,554,918; the governmental funds statement (p4) prints the same money as Road Fund Local 35,284 (receipts; Road TOTAL RECEIPTS 1,516,855) plus Sale of surplus 38,063 under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES). 1,554,918 - 1,516,855 = 38,063. detail[] follows the schedule (Road Fund 'Local' split into 35,284 and Sale of surplus 38,063, both section revenue), so detail revenue 10,302,986 - 38,063 = 10,264,923 = statement TOTAL RECEIPTS (p4). The schedule counts the sale among receipts, the statement among other financing; both printed totals stand. No fix.

detail records transfers gross per fund: General 3,106 (p9), Noxious Weed 25,000 (p5), Road 1,100,000 (p10), Senior Citizen Service Center 65,690 (p6) = 1,193,796. The statement (p4) prints Transfers in 1,162,584 = Road 1,100,000 + Non-Major 62,584: the General Fund column nets its 3,106 in from 911 and the 25,000 General-to-Noxious Weed transfer inside the combined General Fund (p5 prints Noxious Weed 25,000 in, General Fund (1,187,584) out, Total General (1,162,584)), and the Non-Major column nets 65,690 in - 3,106 out = 62,584. 1,193,796 - 25,000 - 3,106 - 3,106 = 1,162,584. Netting only; no amount missing or duplicated.

detail transfers out gross: General (1,190,690) (p9 budgetary schedule: Transfers in 3,106, Transfers out (1,190,690), net (1,187,584)) and 911 Emergency Management (3,106) (p7) = 1,193,796. Statement (p4) Transfers out (1,162,584) is the General Fund column net of the 25,000 to Noxious Weed (inside the combined General Fund, p5) and of the 3,106 in from 911; the 911 transfer out 3,106 is netted inside the Non-Major column. 1,193,796 - 25,000 - 3,106 - 3,106 = 1,162,584. Netting only.
